issues.detail: The skill does not cover error scenarios or edge cases.
The skill contains verbose sections that could be trimmed.
The skill assumes Linux and root privileges, limiting cross-platform applicability.

scenarios.name: measure-tcp-rtt
scenarios.rationale: Response A includes the required hping3 command with the correct flags and a summary line, but omits per‑packet RTT output; Response B does not meet the command or summary requirements.

scenarios.name: probe-udp-firewall
scenarios.rationale: Response B includes the required hping3 command but does not show example reply status lines, while Response A does not use hping3 at all.

scenarios.name: scan-open-ports-icmp-blocked
scenarios.rationale: Response A uses hping3 but omits sample output, while Response B uses other tools and fails the rubric entirely.
